text: Program Description The students mainly study the basic theory and basic knowledge of law, by thinking of law and legal practice of basic training, has the use of legal theory and method to analyze and apply law affairs management and the basic ability to solve the problem. Internship Main practical teaching links: including internship, legal consultation, social investigation, thematic debate, simulated trial, suspect debate, practice, etc., generally no less than 20 weeks. Duration 4 years
